basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Clinical Assistant, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Neurosurgery, AIIMS, New Delhi (Jai Prakash Narayan Apex Trauma Centre, JPNATC) has invited applications for one Clinical Assistant at 35,000 monthly and one Project Assistant at 60,000 monthly on contract under research project T324. Candidates apply through a Google Form with an application/CV and supporting documents; the last date is 7 December 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice asks interested and eligible candidates to submit their application/CV and supporting documents through the application link, a Google Form. The notice also prints a QR code that can be scanned to reach the same link. The last date and time for submission is 07/12/2026; the notice prints no clock time.
Open the application link given in the notice, or scan the QR code printed on it.
Submit the application/CV together with the supporting documents.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications and applications received after the closing date may not be considered. Age limit, experience, eligibility and other service conditions will be as per the approved project requirements and applicable AIIMS/DST rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi
Department of Neurosurgery, AIIMS, New Delhi (JPNATC)
Continuous Closed CSF Glucose Monitoring using CGM Sensor in Patients with External Ventricular Drainage for Early Detection of CSF Infection
Clinical Assistant 35,000 monthly; Project Assistant 60,000 monthly

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, through the Department of Neurosurgery at the Jai Prakash Narayan Apex Trauma Centre (JPNATC). The posts are contractual positions under a research project whose Principal Investigator is Dr. Deepak Agrawal, Professor, Department of Neurosurgery.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts with one vacancy each. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own essential qualification and age limit, as shown above. The notice prints no experience requirement, no desirable qualification and no cut-off date for counting age. It states that age limit, experience, eligibility and other service conditions will be as per the approved project requirements and applicable AIIMS/DST rules. No age relaxation is mentioned. Clinical Assistant: Graduation or Masters; age limit 30 years. Project Assistant: Master of Science; age limit 35 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Support patient screening and coordination. Assist with clinical data and sample-related documentation as per the approved protocol. Maintain study records. Coordinate with the clinical team. Coordinate day-to-day project activities. Support protocol implementation, device/adaptor development and validation, experimental planning, analysis, interpretation, and preparation of reports.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested and eligible candidates to submit their application/CV and supporting documents through the application link, a Google Form. The notice also prints a QR code that can be scanned to reach the same link. The last date and time for submission is 07/12/2026; the notice prints no clock time. Open the application link given in the notice, or scan the QR code printed on it. Submit the application/CV together with the supporting documents. Submit on or before 07/12/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice states that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the interview/selection process. It does not give the interview date, the venue or the criteria for shortlisting. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.text: Incomplete applications and applications received after the closing date may not be considered. Age limit, experience, eligibility and other service conditions will be as per the approved project requirements and applicable AIIMS/DST rules.
